# Volunteer drivers and rural routes

## What it is

A standing pool of volunteer drivers would cover the three rural routes that paid vans reach only twice a week. Riders in outlying townships could book a seat a day ahead.

## Why now

The county mileage grant now reimburses private vehicles, and two churches offered parking for pickup points.

## Open questions

Insurance riders, background checks, and how dispatch confirms a trip without a staff call.
